quotes: Criteo's media spend2 was $4.6 billion in the last 12 months and $1.2 billion in Q3 2026, up 9% year-over-year at constant currency3.

growth_thesis.basis: Rollout plan stated in the release; the market-growth statement comes from the 10-K business section; the revenue effect is not quantified.
growth_thesis.claim: Expansion of Performance Connected TV beyond the U.S. is a stated new-channel driver. It depends on the rollout happening as scheduled and on CTV demand continuing to grow.
quotes: Criteo expands its Performance Connected TV capabilities beyond the U.S., starting with Brazil and Mexico by year-end 2026, followed by Canada, the UK, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Australia, and select additional markets in 2027.
CTV has become the second fastest growing advertising channel after retail media.

growth_thesis.basis: Partnership and availability stated in the release; the importance of commerce data is the company's own view in the 10-K; revenue effect unknown.
growth_thesis.claim: Advertising inside AI assistants is a newer channel Criteo is pursuing. It is now offered in 89 countries through OpenAI's ChatGPT. This only supports growth if brands shift budget into those environments and Criteo's commerce data proves useful there.
quotes: Criteo became OpenAI's first advertising technology partner in March 2026, enabling thousands of brands to advertise on ChatGPT; the offering is now available in 89 countries.
Scaled and differentiated commerce data will be essential in this environment, allowing AI systems to surface relevant products and recommendations in real time.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A; the nine-month counterpoint is also stated there.
growth_thesis.claim: The Supply Side Platform is the one named Performance Media component that grew in Q3, partly offsetting declines elsewhere. Continued growth there would need to outweigh Commerce Growth softness and lower AdTech services.
quotes: partially offset by an increase in our Supply Side Platform

growth_thesis.basis: Segment figures and cause stated in the 10-Q and release; the dependence on Commerce Growth is inferred from segment scale.
growth_thesis.claim: Performance Media is most of the revenue base, so any growth case depends on Commerce Growth stabilizing. Q3 Performance Media revenue was 364,552 of 416,469 total (table in thousands), and its Contribution ex-TAC fell (15)% on soft Commerce Growth.
quotes: primarily reflecting soft performance in Commerce Growth

growth_thesis.claim: Management's own guidance does not point to growth in the near term. It expects full-year Contribution ex-TAC to decrease -12% to -10% at constant currency, and Q4 guidance reflects the Retail Media scope changes. Growth would therefore require results to improve beyond the guided trajectory.
quotes: We continue to expect Contribution ex-TAC to decrease -12% to -10% year-over-year at constant currency.
The Company’s fourth quarter 2026 guidance reflects the impact of previously communicated scope changes in Retail Media.

growth_thesis.basis: Priorities stated in the 10-K; the conditions are inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: The company says its strategic priorities are meant to reaccelerate growth. They include self-service scale through GO, cross-channel expansion and full-funnel capabilities. These only drive growth if self-service adoption among small and mid-sized clients expands without hurting performance.
quotes: We are focused on the following strategic priorities that are expected to reaccelerate growth:
Self-service scale: GO provides advertisers with tools to automate and optimize campaigns efficiently

growth_thesis.basis: Market estimate and risks stated in the 10-K; this is the company's estimate, not independent evidence.
growth_thesis.claim: Retail media market growth supplies the external demand for the Retail Media driver. The company estimates its serviceable market grows at a compound rate of about 20%. This helps Criteo only if it holds or gains share against larger competitors.
quotes: reflecting a compound annual growth rate of about 20%
Certain internet and technology companies have significantly larger resources and capital than we do

growth_thesis.basis: Liquidity stated in the release; the cash flow figures come from the 10-Q statement; the link to growth investment is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Funding for growth investment exists but is tightening. Total liquidity is approximately $788 million. Nine-month capital spending on intangible assets, property and equipment rose to (126,937) from (75,310), while operating cash flow fell to 125,448 from 150,544 (table in thousands). Continued investment needs operating cash flow to recover.
quotes: As of September 30, 2026, the Company had total financial liquidity of approximately $788 million, including $275 million of cash and cash equivalents, $51 million of marketable securities and $462 million available through its revolving credit facility.
